text:
Hi Saygin, I’m a passionate, hard-working freelancer with 6 years of experience in Python and AI work, and I’d love to help create your 5-minute Adcreative AI explainer video.

I’ve built AI systems that combine clear logic with engaging user-facing output, including a contract clause search assistant for a legal client. That project answered questions over 9,000 contracts and always quoted the exact clause and page used, while improving clause lookup from 25 minutes to 3 minutes and reaching 0.91 faithfulness on a lawyer-written test set.

I’m comfortable with script-based AI workflows, screencast-style walkthroughs, and making complex tools feel clear and polished. I can work quickly and deliver the first draft within your 2–3 day target, with the full video completed within 4 days.

I’d be glad to discuss your script and help create something realistic, engaging, and high quality.
